data.gender_notes: Hazmiyah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'h-z-m', meaning 'to remember' or 'to commemorate'. This name is often given to children as a reminder of Allah and His blessings. The name Hazmiyah carries the meaning “Remembrance, Commemoration” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Hazmiyah usually hope their child will grow to embody remembrance, commemoration and live with faith, good character and purpose.

In Islamic tradition, the act of reciting the name of Allah is considered to be a means of drawing closer to Him. By giving a child the name Hazmiyah, parents are conveying their hope that the child will be a constant reminder of Allah and will strive to remember and honor Him in all aspects of their life. Furthermore, the name may serve as a reminder for the child to remember the blessings that Allah has bestowed upon them and to be grateful for them. Overall, the name Hazmiyah represents the importance of remembrance and connection to Allah, both in terms of personal spiritual growth and in preserving religious traditions.
